def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""

    # Validate inputs
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric threshold, not a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("Input must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("Input must be a two-dimensional matrix")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError("All entries must be finite")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError("All entries must be nonpositive")

    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All three input matrices must have the same shape")

    if logp_with_result.shape[0] == 0 or logp_with_result.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices cannot be empty")

    # Build normalized decreasing weights
    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * np.arange(future_horizon))
    weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted averages via matrix multiplication
    avg_with = logp_with_result @ weights
    avg_call_only = logp_call_only @ weights
    avg_no_call = logp_no_call @ weights

    # Margin: benefit of having the API call with result over no call
    margin = avg_with - avg_no_call

    # Keep calls with margin above the threshold
    keep = margin > tau_filter

    return keep.astype(np.bool_), margin
